list.name: pod
list.label: Pod
list.description: The pod label added by Kubernetes scraping. Memory is a per-pod question (the OOM limit is per container): select one pod when reading the by-type panels, which otherwise sum every selected pod. Outside Kubernetes the list is empty and All still matches every series.

panels.title: Failed challenges
panels.description: Challenges whose window ran out: the client got the challenge page itself (usually 403). Over the dashboard range, per scope and requested site. Counted only in scopes with challenge detectors. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare sites are undercounted.

panels.title: Skipped challenges
panels.description: Challenges on requests that asked for no window (challenge_timeout_ms unset or 0): returned as is, never waited on. Over the dashboard range, per scope and requested site. Counted only in scopes with challenge detectors. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare sites are undercounted.

panels.title: Passed challenges
panels.description: Challenges that navigated on to a page not flagged as a challenge within the window. Over the dashboard range, per scope and requested site. Counted only in scopes with challenge detectors. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare sites are undercounted.

panels.title: Iframes by host (top 100)
panels.description: Cross-site iframes loaded over the dashboard range, each frame counted once. Sampled from the browser's target list every second, so frames nested inside other frames are included and frames living under a second may be missed. The block list does not reach iframes. Summed over every site. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare hosts are undercounted.

panels.title: Third-party loads by host (top 100)
panels.description: Cross-site sub-resource loads that went out (not blocked), over the dashboard range. Seen on the page session only: loads made inside a cross-site iframe are not counted here. Summed over every site. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare hosts are undercounted.

panels.title: Blocked loads by host (top 100)
panels.description: Loads dropped by the scope's blocked-URL list or blocked resource types (WORKER_BLOCKED_RESOURCE_TYPES), any host, over the dashboard range. A host absent here that is still in Third-party loads is not matched by any pattern. Summed over every site. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare hosts are undercounted.

panels.title: Iframes by site and host (top 100)
panels.description: Cross-site iframes loaded over the dashboard range, each frame counted once. Sampled from the browser's target list every second, so frames nested inside other frames are included and frames living under a second may be missed. The block list does not reach iframes. page_site is the host the client requested, even after a redirect; unknown for an iframe whose context served no known site. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare hosts are undercounted.

panels.title: Third-party loads by site and host (top 100)
panels.description: Cross-site sub-resource loads that went out (not blocked), over the dashboard range. Seen on the page session only: loads made inside a cross-site iframe are not counted here. page_site is the host the client requested, even after a redirect; unknown for an iframe whose context served no known site. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare hosts are undercounted.

panels.title: Blocked loads by site and host (top 100)
panels.description: Loads dropped by the scope's blocked-URL list or blocked resource types (WORKER_BLOCKED_RESOURCE_TYPES), any host, over the dashboard range. A host absent here that is still in Third-party loads is not matched by any pattern. page_site is the host the client requested, even after a redirect; unknown for an iframe whose context served no known site. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range, so rare hosts are undercounted.

panels.title: Blocked loads by resource type
panels.description: Loads dropped by BlockedResourceTypesMiddleware (WORKER_BLOCKED_RESOURCE_TYPES), per interval, stacked. Empty when the scope blocks no type. A load matched by both the URL list and a blocked type counts here, since Chrome reports both kinds of block identically. HLS/DASH video (segments are xhr/fetch) and anything inside a cross-site iframe are never blocked by type, so they never appear.

panels.title: Blocked loads by site and resource type (top 100)
panels.description: Loads dropped by BlockedResourceTypesMiddleware per site, over the dashboard range: which sites a type block actually touches. Check here first when a site starts failing after a type was enabled. page_site is the host the client requested, even after a redirect. A row with page_site="other" means a worker reached its cap on label combinations (WORKER_THIRD_PARTY_METRICS_MAX_SERIES). increase() misses the first increments of a series that appeared inside the range.
